rv.q: THE STRANGE CASE OF DR. JEKYLL AND MR. HYDE is a mystery to be experienced.

I had real trouble following all the aspects of the story: murder and virtue, rape and seduction, revenge and passion, with snippets of addiction, past sexual molestation, homosexuality, and incongruous heterosexuality tossed in haphazardly.
The current incarnation of this classic horror story works exceedingly well. It is entertaining and imaginative.

cn.t: Critics find this adaptation of the classic tale "diabolically delicious" with clever twists, though one reviewer found it oddly executed. The quick-witted reimagining earns praise for its intriguing take on familiar material.
